title: Settings
appearanceHint: Appearance preferences are saved on this device.
reducedSystem: Following your system’s reduced motion setting
reducedHint: Disable orbit and entrance animations while keeping instant button feedback
codexHint: Live models; sign in to Codex
luminaHint: Lumina gateway for multiple providers; API key required
customApiHint: Self-hosted service compatible with OpenAI or Anthropic
addressInvalid: Enter a full service address, such as http://192.168.1.8:4311
wrongService: No Aura conversation service is running at this address.
connectionFailed: Connection failed. Check the address, network and workbench service.
connectionTimedOut: Connection timed out. Check the workbench address.
modelsHint: Default reply provider for new conversations. Choose workflow modes separately when running them.
defaultCodexHint: Backend defaults; override the model and reasoning effort below each conversation’s input
connectionHint: The service handles conversations, workflows and studio data. On mobile, enter your computer’s LAN IP address.
disconnectHint: Return to the local demo; saved conversations are kept
featuresHint: Enable additional conversation and plugin features as needed.
pluginsHint: Enable plugins and explicitly connect local Action and Flow directories. Plugins run with full Node.js permissions.
recordsHint: Conversations and workspace sessions are saved locally.
historyHint: Browse conversations and workspace sessions by time
archivedHint: View archived conversations in the sidebar. Saved run records are kept.
tagline: Focus on the everyday. Leave room for inspiration.
localDataHint: Conversations and preferences use local browser storage. Model credentials stay on the backend.
